# Speechmatics Academy

> Examples and learning guides for Speechmatics APIs, SDKs, and integrations.

This index supplements the repository documentation. Follow each linked README for setup and access requirements.

Service availability: implementation lifecycle describes this example, not an access guarantee. Check the linked API documentation and your account access before running it. A local demo requires setup; a recording shows a captured session.

## Guides

- [Academy overview](<https://github.com/speechmatics/speechmatics-academy/blob/main/README.md>)
- [Complete example catalog](<https://github.com/speechmatics/speechmatics-academy/blob/main/docs/CATALOG.md>)
- [Catalog maintenance guide](<https://github.com/speechmatics/speechmatics-academy/blob/main/docs/CATALOG_GUIDE.md>)
- [Contributing](<https://github.com/speechmatics/speechmatics-academy/blob/main/docs/CONTRIBUTING.md>)

## Topic and integration guides

- [Healthcare](<https://github.com/speechmatics/speechmatics-academy/blob/main/collections/healthcare/README.md>): Medical transcription, clinical dictation, and consultation interfaces.
- [Telephony](<https://github.com/speechmatics/speechmatics-academy/blob/main/collections/telephony/README.md>): Phone assistants, SIP and Media Streams, and recorded-call analysis.
- [Multilingual](<https://github.com/speechmatics/speechmatics-academy/blob/main/collections/multilingual/README.md>): Translation, bilingual transcription, and multilingual code-switching.
- [Voice agents](<https://github.com/speechmatics/speechmatics-academy/blob/main/collections/voice-agents/README.md>): Speech interfaces, turn handling, and complete conversational pipelines.
- [Captions and insights](<https://github.com/speechmatics/speechmatics-academy/blob/main/collections/captions-insights/README.md>): Captions, live transcript displays, sentiment, topics, and summaries.
- [LiveKit](<https://github.com/speechmatics/speechmatics-academy/blob/main/integrations/livekit/README.md>): Voice assistants with Agent STT, speaker controls, browser tools, and SIP telephony.
- [Pipecat AI](<https://github.com/speechmatics/speechmatics-academy/blob/main/integrations/pipecat/README.md>): Local microphone and browser WebRTC voice agents using the Speechmatics adapter.
- [Twilio](<https://github.com/speechmatics/speechmatics-academy/blob/main/integrations/twilio/README.md>): Phone agents through LiveKit SIP or direct Media Streams; the direct example uses the legacy Voice SDK.

## Examples

- [Hello World - Your First Transcription](<https://github.com/speechmatics/speechmatics-academy/blob/main/basics/01-hello-world/README.md>): Transcribe a sample audio file with the Batch SDK and a minimal custom dictionary. Implementation: current; APIs: Speechmatics Batch API; packages: Speechmatics Batch SDK; languages: Python.
- [Batch vs Realtime - Understanding API Modes](<https://github.com/speechmatics/speechmatics-academy/blob/main/basics/02-batch-vs-realtime/README.md>): Learn the difference between Batch and Realtime transcription modes and when to use each. Implementation: current; APIs: Speechmatics Batch API, Speechmatics Realtime API; packages: Speechmatics Batch SDK, Speechmatics Realtime SDK; languages: Python.
- [Configuration Guide - Common Configuration Options](<https://github.com/speechmatics/speechmatics-academy/blob/main/basics/03-configuration-guide/README.md>): Configure Batch transcription with speaker diarization, a custom dictionary, smart formatting, and model quality settings. Implementation: current; APIs: Speechmatics Batch API; packages: Speechmatics Batch SDK; languages: Python.
- [Text to Speech](<https://github.com/speechmatics/speechmatics-academy/blob/main/basics/06-text-to-speech/README.md>): Convert text to natural-sounding speech using Speechmatics TTS. Implementation: current; APIs: Speechmatics Text to Speech API; packages: Speechmatics Text to Speech SDK; languages: Python.
- [Channel Diarization](<https://github.com/speechmatics/speechmatics-academy/blob/main/basics/10-channel-diarization/README.md>): Transcribe separate audio channels with the Realtime SDK and assign a label to each channel. Implementation: current; APIs: Speechmatics Realtime API; packages: Speechmatics Realtime SDK; languages: Python.
- [Melia 1 Multilingual Transcription](<https://github.com/speechmatics/speechmatics-academy/blob/main/basics/12-melia-multilingual/README.md>): Transcribe code-switching audio with Melia 1 using the Batch SDK and automatic multilingual recognition. Implementation: current; APIs: Speechmatics Batch API; packages: Speechmatics Batch SDK; languages: Python.
- [Speech intelligence - Sentiment, Topics and Summaries](<https://github.com/speechmatics/speechmatics-academy/blob/main/basics/04-audio-intelligence/README.md>): Extract insights with sentiment analysis, topic detection, and automatic summarization. Implementation: current; APIs: Speechmatics Batch API; packages: Speechmatics Batch SDK; languages: Python.
- [Multilingual & Translation](<https://github.com/speechmatics/speechmatics-academy/blob/main/basics/05-multilingual-translation/README.md>): Stream English microphone audio to the Realtime API and display partial and final Spanish and Russian translations. Implementation: current; APIs: Speechmatics Realtime API; packages: Speechmatics Realtime SDK; languages: Python.
- [Basic Turn Detection](<https://github.com/speechmatics/speechmatics-academy/blob/main/basics/07-turn-detection/README.md>): Detect when speech ends using silence-based turn detection for real-time applications. Implementation: current; APIs: Speechmatics Realtime API; packages: Speechmatics Realtime SDK; languages: Python.
- [Intelligent Turn Detection](<https://github.com/speechmatics/speechmatics-academy/blob/main/basics/08-voice-agent-turn-detection/README.md>): Compare client-side turn-detection presets in the deprecated Voice SDK; start new applications with Agent STT. Implementation: legacy; APIs: Speechmatics Realtime API; packages: Speechmatics Voice SDK (deprecated), Speechmatics Realtime SDK; languages: Python.
- [Speaker ID & Speaker Focus](<https://github.com/speechmatics/speechmatics-academy/blob/main/basics/09-voice-agent-speaker-id/README.md>): Extract reusable speaker identifiers and apply speaker focus with the deprecated Voice SDK. Implementation: legacy; APIs: Speechmatics Realtime API; packages: Speechmatics Voice SDK (deprecated), Speechmatics Realtime SDK; languages: Python.
- [Preview WebSocket API Explorer](<https://github.com/speechmatics/speechmatics-academy/blob/main/basics/11-voice-api-explorer/README.md>): Explore raw Python and JavaScript WebSocket clients for the Voice API preview and its older agent profile routes; confirm access before running. Implementation: preview; APIs: Speechmatics Realtime API, Voice API preview; packages: Direct API / configuration; languages: Python, JavaScript. Demo access: Confirm access to the Voice API preview and its older agent profile routes before running. The Voice API preview is a legacy protocol, separate from Agent STT.
- [Agent STT Linden 1 - Segments, Turns and Speakers](<https://github.com/speechmatics/speechmatics-academy/blob/main/basics/13-agent-stt/README.md>): Use Agent STT for transcript segments, speech and turn events, speaker labels and reusable voiceprints, with service VAD or external finalization. Implementation: current; APIs: Speechmatics Agent STT (Linden 1); packages: Speechmatics Agent STT SDK; languages: Python.
- [Agora Conversational AI Voice Agent](<https://github.com/speechmatics/speechmatics-academy/blob/main/integrations/agora/01-conversational-ai-agent/README.md>): Build a Python and TypeScript browser voice agent with Agora RTC/RTM, Speechmatics Realtime transcription, a managed OpenAI LLM, and MiniMax TTS. Implementation: current; APIs: Speechmatics Realtime API; packages: Agora Conversational AI Agents SDK; languages: Python, TypeScript.
- [LiveKit Voice Assistant](<https://github.com/speechmatics/speechmatics-academy/blob/main/integrations/livekit/01-simple-voice-assistant/README.md>): Build a LiveKit voice assistant with Agent STT Linden 1, VAD, speaker diarization and identification, an OpenAI LLM, and ElevenLabs TTS. Implementation: current; APIs: Speechmatics Agent STT (Linden 1); packages: LiveKit Speechmatics STT and TTS plugin; languages: Python.
- [LiveKit Telephony with Twilio](<https://github.com/speechmatics/speechmatics-academy/blob/main/integrations/livekit/02-telephony-twilio/README.md>): Build an inbound phone assistant with Twilio SIP, LiveKit, Agent STT Linden 1, OpenAI, and Speechmatics TTS. Implementation: current; APIs: Speechmatics Agent STT (Linden 1), Speechmatics Text to Speech API; packages: LiveKit Speechmatics STT and TTS plugin; languages: Python. Demo access: Phone testing requires a Twilio number and configured SIP trunking.
- [Speaker Focus Voice Agent](<https://github.com/speechmatics/speechmatics-academy/blob/main/integrations/livekit/03-speaker-focus-voice-agent/README.md>): Filter completed Agent STT turns in a LiveKit application using speaker labels and saved identifiers, with a browser visualizer; focus filtering is application-side. Implementation: current; APIs: Speechmatics Agent STT (Linden 1); packages: LiveKit Speechmatics STT and TTS plugin; languages: Python, JavaScript.
- [Pipecat Simple Voice Bot](<https://github.com/speechmatics/speechmatics-academy/blob/main/integrations/pipecat/01-simple-voice-bot/README.md>): Run a local-microphone Pipecat assistant with Agent STT Linden 1, external VAD finalization, speaker labels, OpenAI, and ElevenLabs. Implementation: current; APIs: Speechmatics Agent STT (Linden 1); packages: Pipecat AI with Speechmatics adapter; languages: Python. Demo access: Requires local microphone and speaker access plus PortAudio; the Web example uses browser audio.
- [Pipecat Simple Voice Bot (Web)](<https://github.com/speechmatics/speechmatics-academy/blob/main/integrations/pipecat/02-simple-voice-bot-web/README.md>): Build a browser WebRTC assistant with Pipecat, Agent STT Linden 1, external VAD and local smart-turn analysis, a Groq LLM, and Cartesia TTS. Implementation: current; APIs: Speechmatics Agent STT (Linden 1); packages: Pipecat AI with Speechmatics adapter; languages: Python. Demo access: Use macOS, Linux, or WSL2 for the documented backend setup; the client runs in a browser.
- [Twilio Outbound Dialer](<https://github.com/speechmatics/speechmatics-academy/blob/main/integrations/twilio/01-outbound-dialer/README.md>): Start outbound Twilio calls and process Media Streams with the deprecated Voice SDK, an OpenAI LLM, and ElevenLabs TTS. Implementation: legacy; APIs: Speechmatics Realtime API; packages: Speechmatics Voice SDK (deprecated); languages: Python. Demo access: Starts real outbound calls. Protect the dial endpoint and validate Twilio callbacks before exposing a tunnel.
- [Vapi Voice Assistant](<https://github.com/speechmatics/speechmatics-academy/blob/main/integrations/vapi/01-voice-assistant/README.md>): Configure a Vapi assistant with Speechmatics Enhanced streaming STT, a custom dictionary, OpenAI, and ElevenLabs. Implementation: current; APIs: Speechmatics Realtime API; packages: Vapi Server SDK; languages: Python.
- [Tambourine Healthcare Dictation](<https://github.com/speechmatics/speechmatics-academy/blob/main/integrations/tambourine/01-healthcare-dictation/README.md>): Configure Tambourine desktop dictation and clinical LLM formatting prompts; its installed STT adapter determines the Speechmatics endpoint and model. Implementation: current; APIs: Speechmatics Realtime API; packages: Direct API / configuration; languages: Configuration. Demo access: Requires a separate Tambourine desktop installation; its installed STT adapter determines the model and endpoint.
- [Medical Transcription - Realtime Enhanced Medical](<https://github.com/speechmatics/speechmatics-academy/blob/main/use-cases/01-medical-transcription-realtime/README.md>): Stream a medical recording with Realtime Enhanced Medical and a custom dictionary for clinical terminology. Implementation: current; APIs: Speechmatics Realtime API; packages: Speechmatics Realtime SDK; languages: Python.
- [Video Captioning](<https://github.com/speechmatics/speechmatics-academy/blob/main/use-cases/02-video-captioning/README.md>): Generate SRT captions for video content with timestamp synchronization and batch processing. Implementation: current; APIs: Speechmatics Batch API; packages: Speechmatics Batch SDK; languages: Python.
- [Call Center Analytics](<https://github.com/speechmatics/speechmatics-academy/blob/main/use-cases/03-call-center-analytics/README.md>): Analyze stereo call recordings with channel labels, sentiment analysis, topic detection, and summaries. Implementation: current; APIs: Speechmatics Batch API; packages: Speechmatics Batch SDK; languages: Python.
- [AI Receptionist](<https://github.com/speechmatics/speechmatics-academy/blob/main/use-cases/04-voice-agent-calendar/README.md>): Build a LiveKit demonstration receptionist with Agent STT, Speechmatics TTS, Twilio SIP, OpenAI tools, and Google Calendar booking. Implementation: current; APIs: Speechmatics Agent STT (Linden 1), Speechmatics Text to Speech API; packages: LiveKit Speechmatics STT and TTS plugin; languages: Python. Demo access: Use a dedicated test calendar: the agent can create, move, and delete real events.
- [Santa Voice Agent](<https://github.com/speechmatics/speechmatics-academy/blob/main/use-cases/05-santa-voice-agent/README.md>): Build a Santa character voice agent with LiveKit, Agent STT, an OpenAI LLM, ElevenLabs TTS, and optional Twilio SIP calls. Implementation: current; APIs: Speechmatics Agent STT (Linden 1); packages: LiveKit Speechmatics STT and TTS plugin; languages: Python.
- [Medical Assistant](<https://github.com/speechmatics/speechmatics-academy/blob/main/use-cases/06-medical-assistant/README.md>): Build a local Arabic and English clinical transcription dashboard with Enhanced Medical on the preview Realtime endpoint, speaker diarization, and OpenAI extraction and SOAP-note drafting; confirm endpoint and language-pack access. Implementation: preview; APIs: Speechmatics Realtime API; packages: Speechmatics Realtime SDK; languages: Python, JavaScript. Demo access: Live transcription requires access to the preview Realtime endpoint and the `ar_en` bilingual language pack. Transcripts are sent to OpenAI; use synthetic or de-identified data. The app has no login. Run Demo uses synthetic transcripts but still requires an OpenAI key and makes billable requests.
- [Medical Microbatching](<https://github.com/speechmatics/speechmatics-academy/blob/main/use-cases/07-medical-microbatching/README.md>): Split microphone audio with Silero VAD and submit concurrent Batch Enhanced jobs, with an optional cross-chunk speaker-identification variant; Medical configuration is optional. Implementation: current; APIs: Speechmatics Batch API; packages: Speechmatics Batch SDK, Speechmatics Realtime SDK; languages: Python.
- [Alphanumerics Voice Form Filler](<https://github.com/speechmatics/speechmatics-academy/blob/main/use-cases/08-alphanumerics-form-filler/README.md>): Fill a local browser form from spoken names, emails, and numbers using Agent STT, Speechmatics TTS, OpenAI tools, and LiveKit RPC. Implementation: current; APIs: Speechmatics Agent STT (Linden 1), Speechmatics Text to Speech API; packages: LiveKit Speechmatics STT and TTS plugin; languages: Python, JavaScript.
- [Flutter Mobile Transcription App](<https://github.com/speechmatics/speechmatics-academy/blob/main/use-cases/09-flutter-mobile-transcription/README.md>): Build a Dart mobile client for direct Batch API transcription, speaker and channel labels, speaker identification, captions and speech intelligence, with optional Google Cloud translation. Implementation: current; APIs: Speechmatics Batch API; packages: Direct API / configuration; languages: Dart. Demo access: Requires a mobile device/emulator and platform toolchain; iOS needs macOS and Xcode. Add keys in-app; do not distribute builds with embedded keys.
- [Wall of Voices](<https://github.com/speechmatics/speechmatics-academy/blob/main/use-cases/10-wall-of-voices/README.md>): Display multilingual microphone transcripts with Melia 1 and per-word language tags; browser audio uses the preview Realtime host, with a Python token broker and optional SDK CLI. Implementation: preview; APIs: Speechmatics Realtime API; packages: Speechmatics Realtime SDK; languages: Python, JavaScript. Demo access: The GIF is a recording; running locally requires microphone access and a key with access to the preview Realtime endpoint.
- [Oak Consultation Studio](<https://github.com/speechmatics/speechmatics-academy/blob/main/use-cases/11-oak-consultation-studio/README.md>): Build an Oak 1 multilingual medical consultation interface with direct browser Batch API uploads, synchronized playback, language and speaker/channel labels, and a Python token broker. Implementation: current; APIs: Speechmatics Batch API; packages: Direct API / configuration; languages: Python, JavaScript. Demo access: Scripted consultations need no key; transcribing your own audio requires a Speechmatics key with Oak 1 Batch access. A key entered in Settings is saved in this browser until cleared and sent to the deployment's `/api/token` endpoint to obtain a 10-minute Batch key.
